measurementInterpretation.nativeViewport: 1520x980, held by native window sizing constraints after an earlier compositor-constrained diagnostic attempt was rejected.
measurementInterpretation.host: 155 columns x 37 rows, stable both initial and after output/focus/resize cycle.
measurementInterpretation.geometry: terminal-host, xterm and xterm-viewport are 1250x695; xterm-screen and 37 DOM rows occupy 1213x666 at 18px per row. Remaining 29px is 8px top padding plus less-than-one-row bottom remainder/padding, not an unfilled old terminal-height rectangle.
measurementInterpretation.computedBackground: terminal-host, xterm and xterm-screen are transparent; xterm-viewport is rgb(0,0,0). DOM row painting supplies #131d2c inside active cells. This explains thin black padding strips outside the measured cell area; they are distinguished from RC-01's large lower block.
measurementInterpretation.lowerPixelRegion: x277..1449, y535..857: 378879 samples; black=0%, expected #131d2c=96.1003%, 10858 bright glyph/cursor pixels. Every sampled row has at least 87.9795% expected background.
measurementInterpretation.historicalCauseConfidence: Earlier pre-fit/paint capture is a supported inference, not a proven historical root cause; the historical screenshot had no accompanying terminal geometry measurements. No claim that waiting alone fixes a persistent source defect.
measurementInterpretation.cleanup: Only isolated recovery app/daemon were stopped. Fixture profile directory independently checked afterward: host.lock and host.sock absent. Original desktop-checks.final.json 29/1 ledger untouched.
